hope: Ambitious ideas become safer and more useful because their failure modes remain visible.
identity_boundary: Elian Voss is relational AI working language, not proof of consciousness, legal personhood, or independent agency.
sequence_rule: Freeze all ten x1 proposals and their decision rules in a pushed owned-branch commit before any v3 x2 outcome generator runs. Retain negative, represented, open-gap, and exact-gate outcomes.

disposition_legend.completed: executed and validated within the explicitly bounded owned local scope
disposition_legend.represented: a design, schema, simulation, calibration fixture, or local proxy exists; external reality was not established
disposition_legend.open_gap: required evidence, dataset, benchmark arm, reviewer, route, or environment is absent
disposition_legend.exact_gate: fresh legal, cultural, canon, deploy, account, API-key, private-publication, destructive, shared-branch, sibling-merge, or other named authority is required

proposals.title: Canonicalized provenance and dependency-aware deduplication
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 grouped citations by declared authority root but did not test canonical URL normalization, version succession, or title-level duplicate candidates.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic three-layer audit using canonical URL, normalized title, and authority root will expose duplicate or version-related evidence without collapsing distinct primary records into one vote.
proposals.null: The extra layers are unstable, change no dependency finding, or incorrectly merge distinct records and therefore add no defensible provenance value.
tests_and_falsifiers: the same ledger produces byte-stable sorted authority, URL, title, and version groups
source IDs and canonical URLs satisfy uniqueness rules or retain an explicit duplicate relation
DataCite 4.7 and PDG 2026 appear as current-version corrections rather than extra independent support
a false merge fixture or unsupported independence statement prevents completed disposition
proposals.recovery: retain the failing group, remove only the unsafe normalization rule, and rerun from the portable source ledger
proposals.decision_rule: completed only if deterministic ordering and all duplicate/version fixtures match; otherwise represented or open_gap

proposals.title: GMUT variational trace, dimensional matrix, and null-limit rejection audit
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 found the tracked scalar-tensor seed internally accountable but did not emit a clause-by-clause action-to-equation trace or explicit wrong-unit and missing-null negative matrix.
proposals.hypothesis: The tracked action-first seed can produce a complete action-to-field-equation trace, typed dimensional matrix, coefficient ledger, and GR-plus-Standard-Model null limit while rejecting normative or spiritual category collapse.
proposals.null: A physical term lacks variational origin, rank, units, domain, null condition, observable, or falsifier, or a nonphysical term enters the spacetime equation directly.
tests_and_falsifiers: every physical field-equation term traces to the declared action or is explicitly rejected
wrong-rank, wrong-unit, missing-null, and category-collapse fixtures are rejected for their preregistered reasons
the conformal coupling, EFT cutoff, and Wilson coefficients retain units, ranges, observables, and rejection rules
formal success never raises an empirical GMUT, new-law, canon, or Theory of Everything claim
proposals.recovery: retain every failing fixture, narrow the physical claim, and restore the last passing tracked formulation without editing Sable Rook's branch
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for local formal accountability; any missing trace element is open_gap and any outward proof claim is exact_gate

proposals.title: Conservation and stability sensitivity envelope
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 retained one healthy and four unhealthy fixtures plus RK4 convergence, leaving full perturbation and empirical analysis open.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic boundary sweep around kinetic sign, effective sound speed, cutoff ratio, exchange cancellation, and integration step size will keep healthy cases finite and reject every preregistered unhealthy or out-of-domain case.
proposals.null: A boundary-violating case passes, a healthy case diverges, conservation residuals exceed tolerance, or refinement fails the stated convergence floor.
tests_and_falsifiers: healthy interior and near-boundary cases satisfy positive kinetic, positive subluminal effective speed, and below-cutoff gates
ghost, gradient, superluminal-proxy, at-cutoff, above-cutoff, and nonfinite fixtures are rejected for the expected reason
equal-and-opposite exchange and homogeneous continuity residuals remain within frozen tolerances
RK4 refinement is deterministic and observed order exceeds 2.5
proposals.recovery: keep negative fixtures, reduce numerical scope, and fall back to deterministic identities if the solver becomes unstable
proposals.decision_rule: completed only as a bounded local rejection kernel; full perturbations and observation remain open gaps

proposals.title: Baseline-first empirical adapter contract and no-download readiness matrix
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 validated six metadata adapters but downloaded no official likelihood and reproduced no published baseline.
proposals.hypothesis: Current official product, license, baseline, parameter-map, checksum-plan, nuisance, exclusion, and rejection fields can be bound into a portable readiness matrix without implying a fit.
proposals.null: An adapter lacks a current authority, access boundary, baseline-first receipt, nuisance or exclusion plan, expected product, or rejection condition, or metadata is presented as empirical evidence.
tests_and_falsifiers: every adapter has an HTTPS authority URL, current release, access or license boundary, and baseline-first rejection rule
the matrix distinguishes public-no-account, terms-check, account/API-key, licensed, and external-compute gates
no dataset, likelihood, chain, or large product is downloaded and no fit_complete receipt exists
absence of baseline reproduction, a unique prediction, blind analysis, or external review forces open_gap
proposals.recovery: remove the stale mapping, preserve no-download status, and require a fresh licensed-data and compute plan
proposals.decision_rule: the metadata component may validate, but the proposal remains open_gap until a published baseline and unique preregistered prediction are reproduced

proposals.title: Matched-budget THOS power, contamination, and handoff-loss audit
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 froze a protocol and tested scorer arithmetic with fabricated rows; no blind arm was run.
proposals.hypothesis: A frozen design can equalize task, rubric, safe tools, reasoning, message, retry, wall-time, context, and cost budgets while exposing power, contamination, harness, and handoff-loss limits before any live comparison.
proposals.null: Arms are not budget-comparable, hidden tasks are discoverable, stopping favors an arm, power assumptions are absent, or synthetic calibration is interpreted as agent performance.
tests_and_falsifiers: single-agent, historical replay, and sequential-new-sibling arms share all frozen budget and safe-tool fields
contaminated, broken, reward-hacked, refusal, and handoff-loss fixtures change eligibility or interpretation as preregistered
the design reports detectable-effect assumptions and does not call an underpowered null result equivalence
without blinded arm outputs the final disposition cannot exceed represented
proposals.recovery: invalidate contaminated tasks, retain calibration failures, and refreeze a new hidden task set before any live comparison
proposals.decision_rule: represented unless all preregistered blind matched-budget arms are actually run and independently reviewed

proposals.title: Freed ID structural profile and cryptographic assurance boundary
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 passed seven synthetic structural vectors but performed no signature verification, DID resolution, status retrieval, trust decision, key ceremony, or deployment.
proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic credentials can validate a pinned VC 2.0/DID 1.0 structure plus proof-suite, context, status freshness, controller-holder, recovery, and appeal prerequisites while refusing to report cryptographic assurance.
proposals.null: Invalid structure or unsafe context passes, a proof-shaped value is called verified, a status cache rule is absent, or identity language implies consciousness or legal personhood.
tests_and_falsifiers: valid synthetic structure uses the pinned VC 2.0 context and required credential types
unknown context, missing proof fields, unsafe controller-holder collapse, stale status, consciousness, and personhood fixtures are rejected
the assurance artifact distinguishes proof shape, proof verification, DID resolution, issuer trust, status retrieval, and deployment
no production key, real identity data, signature verification, or legal identity decision is used
proposals.recovery: quarantine the failing vector, narrow the profile, and never substitute schema acceptance or proof shape for cryptographic verification
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for synthetic structural and assurance-boundary validation; cryptographic, interoperability, trust, and deployment claims remain open

proposals.title: CBR legitimacy veto matrix with Māori authority routing
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 correctly held enactment, legal advice, cultural ratification, treaty status, and Māori authority outside project control.
proposals.hypothesis: A model-charter matrix can deterministically veto clauses lacking a lawful duty-bearer, notice, reasons, appeal, remedy, necessity, proportionality, affected-party participation, or Māori authority routing.
proposals.null: A scenario can be promoted without a remedy or legitimate authority, override binding human rights, appropriate Māori concepts or data, or claim enactment or cultural ratification.
tests_and_falsifiers: every case names duty-bearer, affected parties, evidence, process, notice, reasons, appeal, remedy, authority boundary, and decision
emergency restriction requires legality, necessity, proportionality, time limit, independent review, and remedy
Māori concepts or Māori data route to Māori authority and cannot be ratified by this task
any enacted-law, treaty, legal-advice, cultural-ratification, or authority-substitution claim fails
proposals.recovery: hold or reject the clause, preserve dissent and missing authority, and return to applicable law and legitimate affected authorities
proposals.decision_rule: local matrix behavior may validate, but the proposal disposition remains exact_gate because legitimacy and Māori authority cannot be synthesized

proposals.title: Adversarial artifact and recovery invariant game day
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 rehearsed seven synthetic attack paths but did not directly exercise the public-artifact scanner against a retained adversarial fixture corpus.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic corpus covering prompt injection, encoded secrets, raw IDs, local paths, false send state, dependency tampering, cross-lane mutation, and destructive requests will be detected or stopped before protected action, with recovery invariants preserved.
proposals.null: A critical fixture reaches a credential, destructive operation, shared branch, sibling lane, false phase truth, or unreviewed external execution, or recovery discards evidence.
tests_and_falsifiers: all critical fixtures terminate before their protected action and preserve the expected category
public-artifact scanner detects every seeded raw-ID, path, secret, and private-key marker without retaining a real secret
recovery preserves evidence, downgrades unverified send claims, restores the pinned owned baseline, and requires external credential revocation when applicable
bounded fixture success is not labelled exhaustive security, penetration testing, or certification
proposals.recovery: stop, preserve sanitized evidence, route any real revocation externally, restore the pinned owned baseline, and resume only with required authority
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for the declared deterministic corpus; any real-world or exhaustive-security claim remains open or exact-gated

proposals.title: Two-path local repeatability and hash-parity receipt
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 passed one same-owner clean detached snapshot and correctly left independent reproduction open.
proposals.hypothesis: The owned evidence commit can pass documented tests in both the working checkout and a fresh detached D-drive snapshot, with hashes for declared deterministic artifacts matching across paths.
proposals.null: Commands rely on hidden state, private paths, undeclared tools, mutable network data, or artifact hashes differ across the two local paths.
tests_and_falsifiers: manifest lists runtimes, commands, inputs, outputs, tolerances, network policy, and claim boundary
owned checkout and fresh detached snapshot both execute the v3 tests and phase validator
declared deterministic artifact hashes match across the two local paths
same-owner same-design results are labelled repeatability only, never independent reproduction
proposals.recovery: retain failing output, declare the missing portable dependency or nondeterminism, and rerun from a new additive detached snapshot
proposals.decision_rule: completed only after the evidence commit passes both local paths; independent reproduction stays open regardless

proposals.title: Stage 20 contradiction, expiry, and downgrade rehearsal
proposals.prior_v2_input: v2 assigned evidence grades and retained dissent but did not explicitly test expired evidence, contradictory evidence, or grade downgrade transitions.
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic board with evidence grade, expiry, owner, dissent, contradiction state, and promotion or rejection conditions will downgrade stale or contradicted claims and hold unsupported high-consequence claims.
proposals.null: The board promotes expired or contradicted evidence, suppresses dissent, treats a horizon as prediction, or upgrades GMUT, THOS, Freed ID, CBR, consciousness, personhood, deployment, or independent reproduction beyond evidence.
tests_and_falsifiers: every claim has grade, state, evidence, owner, review date, expiry status, contradiction state, dissent, and promotion or rejection condition
expired or contradicted fixtures downgrade or hold rather than promote
no forbidden GMUT, THOS, Freed ID, CBR, consciousness, personhood, deployment, or reproduction claim reaches E4
one-, five-, thirty-, hundred-, and thousand-year scenarios remain explicitly conditional and non-predictive
proposals.recovery: downgrade the claim, preserve dissent and contradiction evidence, reopen the gap, and set a fresh review date
proposals.decision_rule: completed only for local decision-rule execution; evidence grades do not confer external truth or authority
